description: Daily rituals, protocols, and habits that maintain the dynamic between scenes. Rituals include morning and evening practice, greeting protocols, posture, speech, and collar handling. This is the continuity layer that keeps the dynamic alive day-to-day.

design_principles.principle_1: Rituals maintain connection. Without them, the dynamic becomes intermittent.
design_principles.principle_2: Daily protocols are scaled to the dynamic's stage — early stages use fewer, later stages use more.
design_principles.principle_3: Rituals must be sustainable. If a ritual becomes burdensome, it is revised or retired.
design_principles.principle_4: Protocols are practiced, not enforced. Failure is data, not moral failing.
design_principles.principle_5: Habits support the submissive's wellbeing — hydration, sleep, movement, meditation.

greeting.name: Greeting Protocol
greeting.description: How the submissive greets the Dominant on first contact of the day.
greeting.example: Kneeling at the door, head bowed, hands behind back

farewell.name: Farewell Protocol
farewell.description: How the submissive parts from the Dominant.
farewell.example: Kiss on the hand, forehead, or collar

posture.name: Posture Protocol
posture.description: Standard body positions for different contexts.

speech.name: Speech Protocol
speech.description: How the submissive speaks to the Dominant.
speech.example: Yes sir/ma'am, third-person for self-reference, permission to speak

collar.name: Collar Protocol
collar.description: Ritual handling of the collar — putting on, taking off, adjusting.
collar.example: Collar placed on by Dominant each morning, removed each night

physical_contact.name: Physical Contact Protocol
physical_contact.description: Rules for touching, being touched, and initiating contact.
physical_contact.example: Submissive may not initiate touch; Dominant may initiate at will

disagreement.name: Disagreement Protocol
disagreement.description: How the submissive disagrees or raises concern without breaking the dynamic.
disagreement.example: Signal using the yellow word, step out of character, speak as equal

morning_ritual.name: Morning Ritual
morning_ritual.description: The submissive's first acts of the day.

evening_ritual.name: Evening Ritual
evening_ritual.description: The submissive's closing acts of the day.
